question:
The following diagram depicts a ______ cell.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95efc7bce0833fb397596023e4add9f691500f29c31bd8a8450ab67f6a6c45a7.png]
solution:
The correct answer is __**Memory**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Computer memory** is the **storage space in the computer.**
 
• The data is to be processed and instructions required for processing are stored.
 
• In computer memory, we perform **read and write operations.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• A storage cell that is capable of storing **one binary digit or binary character,** i.e., one bit, such as a** 0 or a 1.**
 
• Binary data is **primarily stored on the hard disk drive (HDD).**
